finalText:
**Build is clean now, exit 0.**

Two real bugs, both from the bundler's new options shape:

- [options.js](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. Fixed to match.
- [retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw on `undefined` flags instead of treating them as `false`. Fixed.

Rest of the warnings were deprecation noise, left alone.

Next: nothing.
